'''Magical Pokémon Journey: Almond's Adventure Club''' is the fifth monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Magical Pokémon Journey]] manga created by [[Yumi Tsukirino]]. It contains the seventh and eighth chapters of the manga. The chapters originally released in this book were later re-released as part of {{Vol|Magical Pokémon Journey|2}}. As a bonus, it contained a fold-out color poster which was not part of the regular volume.
==Blurb==
'''''POKéMON ON ICE'''''

''More quirky, hillarious adventures in Magical Pokémon Journey! Almond decides to take the Pokémon on an adventure in an underground cave! Can Clefairy, Jigglypuff, and Pikachu tough it out long enough to get a few XP?'' 

''Then, Hazel, Pikachu and their friend go skiing. But are they really wise to enter the territory of the icy Articuno? And, more important, to eat ice cream while it's cold out?''
